name: Lambert
source:
"Good grief… So troublesome…"

An ex-mercenary in Stahl's army. Lethargic and indifferent. He avoids everything troublesome, but somehow younger people find him easy to get along with. As the result, he often has to take care of them. He's also well-liked by small animals. Due to his blunt words and scary face, people tend to misunderstand him. He looks like a cool man of few words, but he actually has a really simple way of thinking. He believes that "big" means "strong", and "delicious food" equals "meat".
